hook: Electrically driven nano-oscillators detect microRNAs, proteins, and small molecules together without labels
hook_turn: detect microRNAs, proteins, and small molecules together without labels
summary: Charged nanoparticles tethered to a gold surface are made to oscillate, and binding of a target changes their charge and so their oscillation, read by plasmonic imaging. This lets one chip detect molecules across a roughly 300-fold range of weight, and it profiled microRNAs in supernatants from patient-derived breast cancer cells in 24 clinical samples. The small sample and pretreated supernatants mean clinical performance is unproven.
title: Dynamic plasmonic imaging of electromechanically driven nano-oscillators for charge-resolved multiplex biosensing.
